questions.prompt: A school-age child has an age-appropriate posterior dominant rhythm during wake. questions.prompt: During review of a possible stage R epoch, the EEG shows low-amplitude mixed-frequency activity and the EOG shows rapid eye movements, but the chin EMG channel is disconnected. What is the best next step before final staging?

questions.prompt: During an epoch scored as N2, the chin EMG briefly increases, but there is no abrupt change in EEG frequency. Which interpretation is best?
